fixes.explanation: No adoption here, baker. The prayer says, “The barren woman gives birth to seven…” (1 Samuel 2:5). One child would be a fine ending, but Hannah's prayer goes bigger than that. Seven, and she's the one giving birth. Even my best batch never came out that generous.

Right, friend. Hannah prays, “for by his own strength shall no man prevail.” (1 Samuel 2:9). That makes the statement False, since her prayer says the opposite of it. Just before that, she says, “He guards the steps of His faithful ones…” (1 Samuel 2:9). I spent years in a junk drawer trying to get out on my own strength, and let me tell you, that drawer did not budge.
